chunks.arabic_text: عَنِ الْهِلالِ إِذَا رَآهُ الْقَوْمُ جَمِيعًا فَاتَّفَقُوا عَلَى أَنَّهُ لِلَيْلَتَيْنِ أَيَجُوزُ ذَلِكَ

translations.en: about the crescent: if the people all see it together and agree that it is for two nights, is that permissible?

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning sighting the crescent for determining the lunar month. It indicates that if a group collectively sees the crescent and agrees that it appears to be of two nights, this judgment is acceptable.
en.seo_question: Is it permissible to rely on a group’s agreement that the moon is a two-night crescent?

key_terms.الْعِيصُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ: Al-‘Īṣ ibn al-Qāsim, the narrator asking the Imam عليه السلام
key_terms.الْهِلالِ: the new crescent moon marking the beginning of a lunar month
key_terms.الْقَوْمُ: the group of people who witnessed the crescent
key_terms.لِلَيْلَتَيْنِ: being judged as a crescent of two nights
key_terms.أَيَجُوزُ: is it permissible; a question about legal validity
